{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter to only completed and converted orders
df_filtered = df[(df['converted'] == 1) & (df['status'] == 'completed')]

# Check for test orders (revenue == 999999.99)
test_orders = df_filtered[df_filtered['revenue'] == 999999.99]
print("Number of test orders in filtered data:", len(test_orders))

# Drop test orders
df_clean = df_filtered[df_filtered['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Check the distribution of customer_segment by channel
cross_tab = pd.crosstab(df_clean['channel'], df_clean['customer_segment'])
print("Cross-tabulation of channel vs customer_segment:\n", cross_tab)

# Compute average revenue per converted order by channel
avg_revenue_by_channel = df_clean.groupby('channel')['revenue'].mean()
print("Average revenue per converted order by channel:\n", avg_revenue_by_channel)

# Compute the difference
difference = avg_revenue_by_channel['email'] - avg_revenue_by_channel['paid_search']

# Print results
print("Final average revenue per converted order (email):", avg_revenue_by_channel['email'])
print("Final average revenue per converted order (paid_search):", avg_revenue_by_channel['paid_search'])
print("Difference (email - paid_search):", difference)"}
